clusters.headline: Saudi Arabian Authorities Address Hajj Fraud And Aerial Security
aiSummaryBullets: The Saudi government has initiated efforts to eliminate illegal brokerage practices within the Hajj services sector.
The Indonesian Ministry of Hajj and Umrah has officially expressed support for the Saudi crackdown on unregulated Hajj service providers.

clusters.headline: Saudi Arabia Implements Capital Punishment For Hashish Trafficking
aiSummaryBullets: Five Ethiopian nationals were executed by Saudi Arabian authorities for smuggling hashish.
The Saudi government maintains capital punishment for various offenses, including drug trafficking.
